blind.description: A stylized wooden apothecary shelving unit stocked with alchemy and herbal supplies. It features four corner posts, three internal shelves, and an exposed top surface. Contents include stoppered amber potion bottles, wicker-wrapped green flasks, round ceramic jars with banded stripes, stone mortars and pestles, and bundles of dried herbs. The back of the unit is enclosed with wooden paneling and horizontal support battens. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and hand-painted in warm brown, sage green, cream, and terracotta tones.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden top with protruding corner post caps, holding a lidded cream jar, a round green bottle, a bundle of dried herbs, and a round amber potion bottle.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches roughly chest-height on the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 3.5 to 4 feet tall) and is about 3 feet wide.
